title: Location Performance
caption: Balanced accuracy at each auscultation position for every CirCor model, in both murmur label spaces and for clinical outcome. Bars are the mean over the five patient-grouped folds with SD whiskers. The hatched position (Phc, 4 recordings corpus-wide) is shown for completeness and is not a result.
notes: Balanced accuracy is used rather than accuracy because murmur is 20.5% positive at recording level and accuracy rewards a model for rarely predicting Present.
